title: Super Athletes take on Swim Serpentine and IRONMAN Weymouth

From open-water swimming to the ultimate test of endurance, our Super Athletes have been going the extra mile – all for a great cause!


Taking on **Swim Serpentine** in London’s Hyde Park and **IRONMAN Weymouth** , three colleagues from Betway Africa and DigiOutsource put their determination, resilience and superdrive to the test, proving that our people know what it means to go *All in* .


With months of training and preparation behind them, our athletes tackled these incredible challenges head-on. But their achievements went far beyond the finish line.


As part of Super Group Cares, our Super Athletes turned their personal goals into an opportunity to give back, **raising over £900 for charity** and making every stroke, pedal and kilometre count.


A huge congratulations to our Super Athletes and the causes they championed:


- **Cassandra de Wet** , Betway Africa, Johannesburg – Sue Ryder
- **Jessica Strydom** , Betway Africa, Johannesburg – Sue Ryder
- **Charlene Groenwald** , DigiOutsource, Cape Town – I Love Boobies


Their achievements are a brilliant reminder of what we can accomplish when we combine personal ambition with a passion for making a difference.


That’s what Super Group Cares is all about. Empowering our people to push boundaries, champion causes close to their hearts and go *All in* to create a positive impact in communities around the world.


Congratulations to all three athletes on a truly superclass achievement!
